work.title: An Essay in Aid of a Grammar of Assent

capture_methods.source: The exact retained pg34022-images.html ZIP member was extracted to a bounded external runtime directory and captured with headless Playwright at 1280 by 1800 pixels using source structural anchors.
capture_methods.tei: The unchanged retained TEI candidate was rendered with build/tools/tei_viewer_screenshot.py and the repository CETEIcean verification viewer.

comparisons.observation: Both sides visibly retain the title, Newman attribution, Latin epigraph, London publisher, 1874 date, contents, dedication, and opening part/chapter. The Project Gutenberg redistribution wrapper visible on the source side is deliberately excluded. TEI preserves the source title line breaks as lb elements, title paragraphs as p elements, and contents as a list; the shared verification viewer is structural rather than a facsimile and does not apply block CSS to every one of those custom elements.
Both sides show the preceding pages 152 and 153 followed by page 157, Part II, Chapter VI, its opening paragraph, page 158, page 159, and section 1 Simple Assent in the same order.

Both sides retain the closing Christianity argument on pages 488 through 491, the final biblical quotation, page 492, the terminal Note, its Chillingworth discussion, its structured references, and page 493.
Both sides show pages 355 through 358 and retain the source's italic Greek-labeled transliteration phronesis, including repeated occurrences, alongside the surrounding italic and Latin typography.
